core_principle: Do not cap GOLD winners at 0.75R-1R. Fix initial risk, classify whether the move is a snapback or trend resumption, and preserve a runner for 3R-6R potential.

time_contract.entry: exact M1 open at confirming M5 close

setup.m15_overextension: 2023 quantiles of 16-bar return / ATR14 at 5%, 7.5% and 10% tails

confirmation.HOLD_BOS: two M5 closes on reversal side of EMA20 and close beyond prior 3-bar structure
confirmation.RETEST_REBREAK: first M5 BOS, pullback to EMA20 within six bars, then re-break beyond prior 2-bar structure

initial_stop.STRUCT_SETUP: setup episode extreme plus 0.10 M15 ATR buffer; risk clipped to 0.75-1.50 ATR
initial_stop.STRUCT_CONFIRM: confirmation swing extreme plus 0.10 M15 ATR buffer; risk clipped to 0.50-1.25 ATR

external_role.reason: these periods have already been exposed in prior research
